# rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry

Vendor-neutral tracing core for Yii3. Ergonomic `trace(name, callback)` facade
over a swappable OpenTelemetry-compatible backend. Namespace `Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry`.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry
```

Backend (real export, Sprint 2): `rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry-otel`. Without it,
bind `TracerProviderInterface => NullTracerProvider` in the app.

## Rules

- Core depends on `open-telemetry/api` (thin). Types mirror OTel, no parallel
  model: `TraceKind->value == SpanKind::KIND_*`, `SpanStatusCode->value ==
  StatusCode::STATUS_*`, `TraceContext` = W3C fields.
- `config/di.php` binds ONLY the facade (`Tracer`, `TracerInterface`). NEVER bind
  `TracerProviderInterface` in core — one source owns it (backend or app), else
  `yiisoft/config` `Duplicate key`.
- `trace()` contract is frozen at 1.0.0 (roave/bc-check). Do not add methods to
  `SpanInterface`/`TracerInterface` after the 1.0.0 tag.
- `currentSpan()` is never `null` — a dropped/disabled span returns a
  non-recording span.
- Two clocks, never mixed: `now()` (wall, PSR-20) vs `monotonicNanos()` (duration).
- PHP 8.3+, 64-bit only.

## API

### Tracer facade

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\{Tracer, SpanInterface, TraceKind, SpanStatusCode};

$value = $tracer->trace(
    name: 'checkout.process',
    callback: static fn (SpanInterface $span): string => $span->setAttribute('k', 'v') ?? 'ok',
    attributes: ['user.id' => '7'],   // array<string, bool|int|float|string|array|null>
    scoped: true,                     // default true; span becomes currentSpan()
    traceKind: TraceKind::Internal,   // Internal|Client|Server|Producer|Consumer
    startNanos: null,                 // backdate span start (unix-epoch ns); null = now
);

$tracer->currentSpan();  // SpanInterface, never null
$tracer->getContext();   // TraceContext (invalid if none active)

// Manual span for split begin/end (caller ends it; NOT activated):
$span = $tracer->startSpan('db.query', ['db.system' => 'sql'], TraceKind::Client);
// ... work ...
$span->end();
```

trace() contract: returns callback value; on throw → recordException + status
Error + end + rethrow; nested trace inherits parent traceId; end() idempotent.
startSpan() = trace() minus callback/scoped/auto-end; parent = active span.

### SpanInterface

```php
$span->setAttribute(string $key, bool|int|float|string|array|null $value): void;
$span->updateName(string $name): void;
$span->setStatus(SpanStatusCode $code, ?string $description = null): void;
$span->addEvent(string $name, array $attributes = []): void; // timestamped OTel span event
$span->recordException(\Throwable $e): void;
$span->end(): void;               // idempotent
$span->isRecording(): bool;       // false for NullSpan / after end
$span->getTraceContext(): TraceContext;
```

The concrete `Span` (LogTracer) adds getters: `getName()`, `getKind()`,
`getStatus(): SpanStatus` (value object: `code: SpanStatusCode`,
`description: ?string`), `getAttributes()`, `getEvents(): list<SpanEvent>`
(`name`, `attributes`, `wallNanos`), `getRecordedExceptions()`,
`getDurationNanos()`, `hasEnded()`.

### Tracers / providers

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\{NullTracer, NullTracerProvider, LogTracer};

new LogTracer($psrLogger);                 // dev: records real spans, logs each
NullTracer::instance();                    // no-op
new Tracer($tracerProvider);               // facade; provider->getTracer()
(new NullTracerProvider())->getTracer();   // => NullTracer
```

### TraceContext (W3C)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\TraceContext;

$ctx = new TraceContext(
    traceId: '0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c', // 32 lowercase hex
    spanId: 'b7ad6b7169203331',                  // 16 lowercase hex
    traceFlags: 1,                               // 0..255, bit 0 = sampled
    traceState: '',                              // opaque tracestate
);
$ctx->isValid();   // false for all-zero (TraceContext::invalid())
$ctx->isSampled();
$ctx->equals($other);
```

Constructor throws `Exception\InvalidArgumentException` on malformed id/flags.

### Propagator

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\TraceContextPropagator;

$p = new TraceContextPropagator();
$ctx = $p->extract($serverRequest);          // incoming ServerRequestInterface
$req = $p->inject($ctx, $clientRequest);     // outgoing RequestInterface (+traceparent)

// Carrier-agnostic (queues, AMQP, gRPC metadata) — plain header maps:
$headers = $p->toHeaders($ctx);              // ['traceparent' => ..., 'tracestate'?]; [] if invalid
$ctx = $p->fromHeaders($headers);            // case-insensitive names; invalid if absent
```

### Clock

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\{ClockInterface, SystemClock};

$clock = new SystemClock();      // implements Psr\Clock\ClockInterface + monotonicNanos()
$clock->now();                   // \DateTimeImmutable (wall)
$clock->monotonicNanos();        // int (hrtime, for durations)
```

### Instrumentation (backend-agnostic; wire app-side, never in core di.php)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\{HttpClientSpanDecorator, TracingCacheDecorator, DbQueryProfiler, ViewRenderSpanListener};

new HttpClientSpanDecorator($psr18Client, $tracer);   // PSR-18 → 'HTTP <method>' + traceparent inject
new TracingCacheDecorator($psr16Cache, $tracer);      // PSR-16 → 'cache.<op>'
$connection->setProfiler(new DbQueryProfiler($tracer, dbSystem: 'postgresql')); // yiisoft/db → 'db.query' (parameterized SQL only; dbSystem default 'sql')
// yiisoft/view PSR-14 (config/events.php):
//   BeforeRender::class => [[ViewRenderSpanListener::class, 'beforeRender']]
//   AfterRender::class  => [[ViewRenderSpanListener::class, 'afterRender']]
```

- `yiisoft/db` / `yiisoft/view` are `suggest` (optional); their symbols are in
  `composer-require-checker.json`; `guzzlehttp/guzzle` is `suggest` too.
- HTTP + cache use `trace()`; DB + view use `startSpan()` (split begin/end).

### Propagation opt-out, Guzzle, queues

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\{GuzzleTracingMiddleware, PropagationPolicy, QueueTracing};

// Span always recorded; traceparent injected per policy. Defaults inject everywhere.
new HttpClientSpanDecorator($c, $tracer, propagate: false);                       // never inject
new HttpClientSpanDecorator($c, $tracer, propagateTo: ['api.internal', '*.svc.local']); // allowlist
// entries: exact host or leading `*.` (subdomains only, not apex); case-insensitive;
// invalid entry => Exception\InvalidArgumentException
$policy = new PropagationPolicy(enabled: true, hosts: ['api.internal']);
$policy->allows($uriOrHostString): bool;

// Guzzle (suggest): span ends on promise settle (async/Pool ok); after a retry
// middleware => span per attempt, before it => span per logical call.
$stack->push(GuzzleTracingMiddleware::create($tracer, $policy), 'tracing');

// Queues (queue-agnostic; yiisoft/queue has no tagged release). Producer / consumer:
$queue = new QueueTracing($tracer);   // + optional TraceContextPropagator, ClockInterface
$metadata = $queue->inject($metadata, enqueuedAtNanos: null, availableAtNanos: null); // traceparent + telemetry.enqueued_at_nanos
$result = $queue->consume($metadata, 'process email.send', fn (SpanInterface $s) => $handle(), ['messaging.system' => 'x']);
```

`consume()`: Consumer span per message, parented to the producer (fresh root if no
valid headers; activated via the OTel context API, so the OTel backend is needed
for parenting), always ended, exception => recorded + Error + rethrown. Queue time
is attribute `messaging.message.queue_time_nanos` (span duration = processing only).

### Log correlation / trace id exposure

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\{TraceContextLogger, TraceIdResponseHeaderMiddleware};

// PSR-3 decorator: adds trace_id/span_id to log context inside an active trace;
// never overwrites caller-provided keys; pass-through when no valid context.
$logger = new TraceContextLogger($innerPsr3Logger, $tracer);

// PSR-15, opt-in, place AFTER (inside) the tracing middleware. Sets the header
// only when the context is valid. Empty header name throws.
new TraceIdResponseHeaderMiddleware($tracer);                    // X-Trace-Id
new TraceIdResponseHeaderMiddleware($tracer, headerName: 'T-R'); // custom
```
